description: Publishes an exact reviewed draft version only after the Preview quality loop. Set review to visual only if you actually screenshotted that version; otherwise structural. Do not publish a failing layout. Success requires ok and receipt:paint. Failed rendering preserves the previous component.

review.description: visual if you actually screenshotted this exact version after the Preview quality loop; structural if you only inspected source/metadata. Never claim visual without a screenshot. Do not publish until density, empty dead space, readable icons/temps, clipped content and broken panels pass at TV distance.
